about.title: About the service
about.whatIs.body: An open-source tool for real-time group risk assessment. The facilitator starts a session, participants join with the session code or QR code and vote anonymously straight from their phones – no accounts, no sign-in.
about.saved.body: The session title, risks, labels and votes are stored temporarily on the server (for at most __TTL_HOURS__ hours) and then deleted automatically.
about.careful.body: Everything in the session can be seen and downloaded by anyone who has the session code. Therefore never enter sensitive data, personal data or confidential information.
about.cookies.body: The service uses no cookies. On your own device, only a randomly generated client key (needed to vote) and the list of your recent sessions are stored.
about.ip.body: To protect the service against abuse, IP addresses are handled temporarily in the server's memory and logs. They are not used for tracking and are never stored in the session data.
